nodes.description: Caller-supplied address exposed through Context._msgSender(); used for all role and allowance authorization checks.
AccessControl mapping bytes32 role => RoleData (member set and admin role) governing privileged functions.
ERC20 balance mapping address => uint256 mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 nested allowance mapping owner => spender => uint256 written by _approve.
Total ERC20 supply, incremented by _mint and decremented by _burn.
Pausable flag blocking token transfers while true.
bytes32 constant role identifier required to call mint().
bytes32 constant role identifier required to call pause()/unpause().
bytes32 constant root admin role able to grant and revoke other roles.
AccessControl.grantRole(bytes32,address); requires caller to hold the role's admin role, then calls _grantRole.
AccessControl.revokeRole(bytes32,address); requires caller to hold the role's admin role, then calls _revokeRole.
AccessControl.renounceRole(bytes32,address); requires account == _msgSender() before revoking.
Internal helper that adds the account to the role member set and emits RoleGranted.
Internal helper that removes the account from the role member set and emits RoleRevoked.
Internal role bootstrap used from the constructor; performs no caller authorization check.
AccessControl.hasRole(bytes32,address) view used by all permissioned entry points.
ERC20PresetMinterPauser.mint(address,uint256); checks MINTER_ROLE then mints new tokens.
ERC20PresetMinterPauser.pause(); checks PAUSER_ROLE then sets _paused = true.
ERC20PresetMinterPauser.unpause(); checks PAUSER_ROLE then sets _paused = false.
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256); moves tokens from _msgSender() to recipient via _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256); transfers and decrements allowance using SafeMath.sub.
ERC20.approve(address,uint256); sets allowance of spender for _msgSender() via _approve.
Internal ERC20 transfer that mutates _balances and triggers _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Internal ERC20 mint that increases _totalSupply and _balances[account].
Internal ERC20 burn that decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Internal ERC20 allowance writer that sets _allowances[owner][spender].
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address,uint256); adds to the caller's allowance via SafeMath.add.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address,uint256); subtracts from the caller's allowance via SafeMath.sub.
ERC20Burnable.burn(uint256); destroys tokens owned by _msgSender().
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom(address,uint256); reduces allowance and burns tokens of another account.
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256); forwards all gas to recipient through a low-level call.
Context._msgSender(); returns msg.sender and is the single abstraction point for caller identity.
Hook invoked before every transfer/mint/burn; ERC20Pausable override enforces !paused().
recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue; forwards all gas to an arbitrary address before any state reconciliation, enabling reentrancy.
SafeMath.sub on the caller allowance in transferFrom/burnFrom/decreaseAllowance; reverts on underflow.
SafeMath.sub applied to _balances[sender] in _transfer and _balances[account] in _burn.
SafeMath.add applied to _totalSupply and recipient balances during minting.
EnumerableSet._remove swap-and-pop array rewrite (toDeleteIndex = valueIndex - 1, lastIndex = length - 1) that reorders _values and rewrites _indexes.
bytes32 role argument of grantRole/revokeRole/renounceRole, used to index _roles.
address account argument identifying the grantee/revokee of a role or the allowance owner.
uint256 amount argument governing how many tokens are transferred, minted or burned.
address to argument of mint(), the recipient of newly created tokens.
address recipient argument of transfer/transferFrom, the destination of the balance credit.
address sender argument of transferFrom, the debited account.
address spender argument of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance, the allowance beneficiary.
Local computed remaining allowance in burnFrom, derived from SafeMath.sub result.
Local bytes32 lastvalue cached before the swap-and-pop rewrite in EnumerableSet._remove.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by Context._msgSender(), the caller abstraction used everywhere.
grantRole authorizes _msgSender() against the role admin via hasRole.
revokeRole authorizes _msgSender() against the role admin via hasRole.
renounceRole requires account == _msgSender() before revoking privileges.
mint() gates token creation on hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()).
pause() gates state freezing on hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, _msgSender()).
unpause() gates state unfreezing on hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, _msgSender()).
Caller identity is the account argument fed into hasRole lookups.
transfer debits _msgSender() as the source of funds.
transferFrom consumes _msgSender() allowance and passes it as the spender.
approve sets the allowance owner to _msgSender().
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as both owner and spender index.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as both owner and spender index.
burn destroys tokens of _msgSender().
burnFrom reads the _msgSender() allowance before burning another account's tokens.
transfer forwards to the internal _transfer implementation.
transferFrom forwards sender/recipient/amount into _transfer.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new total through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced total through _approve.
burnFrom re-approves the decreased allowance before burning.
burnFrom calls _burn on the target account.
burn calls _burn for _msgSender().
burnFrom computes allowance.sub(amount) inside SafeMath, the subtraction guarded against underflow.
The SafeMath.sub result becomes the local decreasedAllowance value.
decreasedAllowance is consumed by burnFrom when re-approving.
_transfer debits and credits _balances entries.
_transfer subtracts amount from _balances[sender] through SafeMath.sub.
_mint credits the recipient balance.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply and balances via SafeMath.add.
_burn debits the account balance.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn subtracts amount from _balances[account] via SafeMath.sub.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping for owner/spender.
mint() calls _mint(to, amount) to create tokens.
mint() calls hasRole to verify the MINTER_ROLE permission.
pause() calls hasRole to verify the PAUSER_ROLE permission.
unpause() calls hasRole to verify the PAUSER_ROLE permission.
pause() sets _paused to true.
unpause() sets _paused to false.
grantRole delegates the membership mutation to _grantRole.
revokeRole delegates the membership mutation to _revokeRole.
renounceRole removes the caller's own membership through _revokeRole.
grantRole is guarded by hasRole on the role's admin role.
revokeRole is guarded by hasRole on the role's admin role.
_grantRole inserts the account into _roles[role].members.
_revokeRole removes the account from _roles[role].members.
_setupRole grants an initial role with no authorization check.
hasRole queries the _roles member set through EnumerableSet.contains.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before minting.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before burning.
The pausable hook reads _paused and reverts transfers while paused.
sendValue performs a low-level value call, handing control to an arbitrary recipient with all remaining gas.
The cached lastvalue local is consumed by the swap-and-pop rewrite.
The role parameter indexes _roles and is validated against the caller's admin role.
The account parameter is the grantee inserted into the role member set.
The amount parameter sizes the balance debit and credit in _transfer.
The amount parameter is burned from the target account through _burn.
The to parameter becomes the recipient in _mint.
The recipient parameter receives the credited balance in _transfer.
The sender parameter is the debited account in _transfer.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance being written in _approve.

normalization_plan.reason: The bytes32 role argument only has meaning as the key into _roles validated inside grantRole/revokeRole.
The account argument is the grantee/revokee whose membership is mutated by grantRole and _grantRole.
The amount argument is consumed as the transferred quantity inside the _transfer balance arithmetic.
The to argument is the beneficiary address credited by _mint.
The recipient argument is the destination of the balance credit performed by _transfer.
The sender argument is the debited account in the _transfer balance subtraction.
The spender argument indexes the allowance slot written by _approve.
The local decreasedAllowance is only used to re-approve within burnFrom.
The local lastvalue exists solely to feed the swap-and-pop array rewrite.
